messages:
maya: hey, console showing a negative remaining quota for customer `acct_42` after a resumed streaming session. spotted during a canary run.
ajay: hmm that sounds like a resume + model swap edge. did it trigger a fallback route?
maya: yup — their client reconnected, the router switched to the smaller model (cost-diff) and we also invoked the external tool (reranker) mid-stream. UI shows -12 tokens.
sam: can you paste the session id + logs?
maya: session=ses_20260315_9f2b, stream_id=st_88, logs: ```2026-03-15T14:12:02Z INFO resume session=ses_20260315_9f2b stream=st_88 route=region-e -> region-w model=redwood-lite fallback=true tool=rerank request_id=req_abc123```
ajay: ok looks like two things: (1) router created a new invoiceable path when it routed to region-w/model-lite; (2) tool call created a separate charge event that wasn't deduped with the original prefix accounting when resume happened.
lia: from product side, customers see a negative quota (console shows remaining < 0) which is confusing. we should clearly separate provisional (streaming-inflight) vs committed charges in the UI.
sam: telemetry note: our ledger emits provisional_token entries on every fragment. on resume we replay fragments and then confirm, but if route/model changes we currently write an extra provisional for the same logical tokens. fix could be to tag provisional entries with original_session_id + resume_nonce and dedupe on confirm.
ajay: implementation thoughts: add resume_parent_id to router metadata. on resume, set `resume_parent_id=ses_20260315_9f2b` in all downstream charge events. ledger will dedupe by (resume_parent_id, token_offset). also de-dup tool charges by toolcall_id + parent_session_id.
maya: agree. quick mitigation: console should floor display at 0 and show a tooltip "under investigation - provisional accounting in flight". Lia ok with that for canary.
lia: yeah short-term ok but must be behind a feature flag for customers. also add a banner in the customer's billing view that provisional tokens may lag.
ajay: I'll prototype ledger dedupe. rough patch: ```sql
-- pseudo
INSERT INTO provisional_tokens(off, count, session, resume_parent)
SELECT off, count, session, resume_parent
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provisional_tokens p2 WHERE p2.resume_parent = resume_parent AND p2.off = off);
```
sam: add a telemetry metric `resume_double_provisional_count` and increment when we detect duplicate provisional writes. need dashboards for SLO.
maya: deployed into canary 3, still reproducing but negative delta decreased.
billing-bot: alert: customer acct_42 provisional balance changed by -12 (now reconciled pending).
ajay: action items: ajay -> ledger dedupe PR (ETA 2d), sam -> add metric + dashboard panel (ETA 1d), lia -> console tooltip + feature flag (ETA 1d), maya -> monitor canary and post repro logs.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch/ledger-dedupe -> canary (build 5123).
maya: thanks, will follow up with a minimal repro and link to logs. :thumbsup:
